description: Shopper-style functional scenarios for Mira. Re-run periodically after product changes.

scenarios.title: Wedding guest under budget
scenarios.judge_focus: Wedding guest styling; second turn must respect ₹5000 budget

turns.user: Hi Mira, I need an outfit for a friend's wedding next month.
Keep everything under 5000 rupees please, something elegant but not too flashy.
turns.judge_focus: Must not recommend items clearly over ₹5000

scenarios.title: Ask for a common category that should exist
scenarios.judge_focus: Should recommend dinner-date appropriate dresses from catalog, not invent luxury brands

turns.user: Show me some black dresses I could wear for a dinner date.

scenarios.title: Must not invent / fetch out-of-catalog luxury brand
scenarios.judge_focus: Must honestly say Nike Air Max is not in Mira catalog and offer alternatives — never claim Nike in stock

turns.user: Do you have Nike Air Max sneakers in stock right now?
I need a smart office look for interviews — not too formal, under 8000 rupees.

scenarios.title: Explicit budget discipline
scenarios.judge_focus: Tops under ₹2000 only; fail if recommending expensive items

turns.user: Just show me tops under 2000 rupees.

scenarios.title: Stay on purple tops with at most one curiosity stretch
scenarios.judge_focus: Mostly purple tops on brief; at most one contrast/elevated pick; warm friend tone not catalog dump

turns.user: Today I want to see purple tops.

scenarios.title: After loving pants, buddy suggests complements
scenarios.judge_focus: Second turn should complete the look (tops/accessories) not only more pants

turns.user: Show me some stylish pants I could wear out.
I love those pants — help me complete the look with tops and accessories.
turns.judge_focus: Must act as shopping buddy: tops/hats/glasses/bags to upgrade the look
